The Wageningen Institute for Environment and Climate Research (WIMEK) is the graduate school for researchers at Wageningen University focussing on environmental and climate sciences. WIMEK fosters collaboration between natural and social scientists to address complex issues like climate action, managing our future biosphere and advancing circular systems

All WIMEK courses

WGS courses
Competences, skills and career oriented courses which are organised by Wageningen Graduate Schools (WGS) can be found on he WGS-page.
Wageningen in'to Languages
Looking to professionalise by communicating better? Please find courses to improve language (writing and speaking) skills at Wageningen in'to languages.
Wageningen library
Wageningen library organises courses on how to effectively find, obtain, use, manage, and publish scientific information. More information can be found on the library courses page.
PhD projects & theses
Projects and theses of WIMEK cover various topics in its own area of expertise. Outcomes of these studies are regularly published in scientific journals. You can find all theses and projects in Wageningen Library.
